options.label: Passenger density
options.help: How many passengers wait at stops. The time of day still changes it.

options.label: Scoring strictness
options.help: How hard punctuality, comfort and safety are judged.

options.label: Trip clock speed
options.help: 1 = real speed. Higher values make the trip clock (and the sky) run faster.

options.label: Stop markers in the world
options.help: The stop's bay on the road as in the game's bus mode: corner markers red while you come, orange in the bay, green when done; its name and who waits over it.

options.label: Next trip from here card
options.help: A card at the top of the Stops tab: the next departure from the stop you stand at, one press to start it.

options.label: LED board in the bus
options.help: The HUD's LED board with the next stop and 'on request', and the bell when a passenger asks for a stop.

options.label: Live comfort
options.help: Standing passengers and the cup on the HUD; a hard brake with people standing makes one fall (-30 comfort).

options.label: Shifts with a dispatcher
options.help: Adds a "Start a shift" button to the route card: a chain of trips with layovers at the termini and a summary at the end.

options.label: Shifts start at the depot
options.help: A shift may begin with an empty service run from the nearest bus depot (or bus station) to the first stop.

options.label: Data service port
options.help: The port of the Earth Bus Routes data service (the program that fetches bus routes from OpenStreetMap). Change it only if another program uses 47630.
